title: Read shared documents
description: Reads, through the native application data broker, the reference of one shared document (with the permissions of the caller), or lists the references the caller may read when doc_id is empty. Only the rights of the caller apply.

include_pdf.description: oui to also return the issued PDF (base64, 5 MiB at most, checked against the shared sha256); default non

doc_id.description: Document identifier; empty (or absent) lists the references the caller may read

fields.name: doc_id
fields.title: Identifiant du document (vide pour la liste)
